_comment: Character name rules for DragonBreak Online. Read by fork skymp5-server/ts/systems/nameFilter.ts on character creation, re-read when this file's mtime changes so edits need no restart. Names are also checked for shape (see maxWords/allowMidWordCaps) and for uniqueness across every character on the server, which is not configured here.
_blockedComment: Matched after the name is lowercased, leetspeak is folded (0->o, 1->i, 3->e, 4->a, 5->s, 7->t, @->a, $->s) and every character that is not a letter is removed, so 'xXP.u_s_s.yXx' is caught by 'pussy'. Substring match, so keep entries short and specific: a short entry like 'ass' would reject 'Cassandra', which is why it is not here.
_reservedComment: Names nobody may take: staff-looking names and the obvious impersonations.
